text:
olivia: brief sync  orchestration + gateway + LangChain/LlamaIndex partner flow. We need a single-run playbook for marketplace demo + HW perf attach. who can take lead?

raj: I can lead the orchestration integration checklist. Need to confirm supported connector interfaces for LangChain agents and LlamaIndex.

mei: From integrations: ensure gateway adapter implements open call semantics and tool call passthrough. Small sample snippet to include in docs:

```python
from redwood import GatewayClient
client = GatewayClient(api_key=os.getenv('RWD_DEMO'))
resp = client.call_tool('llamaindex_loader', params={ 'doc_id': 'demo-001' })
```

mei: Also we should publish a minimal Terraform + Helm repo for partners to stand up the gateway locally.

connor: Ops asks: attach HW perf for T4 + A10 in artifacts. Also provide an annotated trace showing fallback to quantized model. Example fallback rule: if p95 > 400ms switch to variant: redwood-xxl-int8.

raj: Good. I'll add a "failover" section to the playbook with policy examples and sample routing rules. Eg: route_by: [latency, cost, region] with fallbacks.

olivia: Marketing needs a marketplace blurb and a 15s demo video. Legal needs logo signoff and embargo window. Hardware partner requires a 5-business-day review on co-branded assets. Flagging timeline.

integrations-bot: Created PARTNER-5433 "Orch+Gateway tooling: marketplace demo + HW perf" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PARTNER-5433

mei: I'll scaffold the repo and example LangChain/Agent notebook. Will include README with SDK headers: x-rwd-demo and recommended TTL 72h for demo tokens.

connor: I'll upload perf artifacts to s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/orch-gateway/ and add p50/p95 tables. Also will attach a small prompt regression pack.

raj: Checklist items I'm adding: connector API spec, terraform/helm starter, demo dataset snapshot path, token format + rotation policy, quota config (default 60k tokens), failover rules, marketplace copy pointer, legal signoff steps.

olivia: Action owners: raj (checklist + playbook), mei (starter repo + notebook + demo code), connor (perf artifacts + quota), olivia (coordinate legal + marketing). Target: first drafts by EOD tomorrow; dry-run with partner Thurs.

mei: will PR starter repo by 6pm tomorrow.

connor: perf upload by 4pm tomorrow.

raj: checklist share by 5pm tomorrow.

olivia: great, I'll update PARTNER-5433 and set up the dry-run invite. :rocket:
